description: Source code implementing functions to populate device, endpoint, and resource data structures for IPC communication in a device management system.

methods.name: populateDSResource
methods.description: Populates a DSResource structure from an icDeviceResource, including copying id, uri, ownerId, ownerClass, value, type, mode, and last sync time.

methods.name: populateDSEndpoint
methods.description: Populates a DSEndpoint structure from an icDeviceEndpoint, including copying id, uri, ownerId, profile, profileVersion, and associated resources and metadata.

methods.name: populateDSDevice
methods.description: Populates a DSDevice structure from an icDevice, including copying id, uri, deviceClass, version, managing driver, and associated resources, endpoints, and metadata.
